JiwaDocument.Name: Move PO to Another Warehouse
JiwaDocument.Description:
This plugin adds a button to the purchase order screen ribbon titled "Move PO". This button is only enabled for creditor purchase orders with a status of "Sent" that haven't had any items received in so far.

When clicked, the user is prompted for a destination warehouse, and the selected purchase order is 0-ed out and has it's "Order No." post-fixed with "-Moved". A new purchase order, duplicating the original, is created in the chosen destination warehouse - it gets given the "Order No." of the original purchase order.

Only members of a group called "Move PO to Another Warehouse" will be able to see the "Move PO" button.
